sentences.text: Garbage rules come from MARPOL Annex five.
Plastics, including monofilament fishing line, nets and bags, may never be discharged anywhere.
Food waste may be discharged only well offshore: three nautical miles or more if it’s ground up, and twelve nautical miles or more if it isn’t.
Most other garbage, like paper, glass and metal, may not be thrown overboard at all and must be brought ashore.
Inside three miles and on inland waters, nothing goes overboard.
The simplest rule for a charter boat: bring everything back to the dock.
